title: Retail Media Strategy & Growth Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a strategic powerhouse to lead our Retail Media planning and growth initiatives. This role is designed for someone who breathes the marketplace ecosystem and understands that Ads are just one part of a larger business engine. You will be responsible for designing full-funnel strategies across Amazon, Mercado Livre, Shopee, and Magalu , ensuring that media investments translate into sustainable bottom-line growth for our clients.


Key Responsibilities

* Strategic Planning: Design comprehensive Retail Media strategies (Paid & Organic) aligned with clients' business goals, inventory levels, and seasonal cycles.

* Ecosystem Integration: Master the interplay between media, pricing, buy-box dynamics, and SEO/Content across different marketplaces.

* Bottom-Line Accountability: Go beyond ROAS. Analyze the impact of Ads on the overall operation (Total ACOS, Contribution Margin, and Incremental Sales).

* Performance Monitoring: Oversee the evolution of results, identifying gaps in the funnel and pivoting strategies in real-time to protect client profitability.

* Client Advisory: Act as a strategic consultant for high-level stakeholders, translating complex data into business growth roadmaps.

* AI-Driven Optimization: Leverage ProfitlogiQ’s AI tools to predict trends and automate strategic insights.


Qualifications & Skills

* Deep Marketplace Expertise: Solid experience with Amazon Advertising, Mercado Ads, and other Retail Media networks.

* Previous experience in strategic planning is required.

* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of e-commerce P&L, retail math, and supply chain basics.

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to see the "big picture" and connect media metrics to business outcomes.

* Data Storytelling: Proficiency in transforming raw data into compelling strategic narratives.

* Languages: Full professional proficiency in English or Spanish (Mandatory).

* Advanced Tools: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets and familiarity with BI tools (Looker, PowerBI).


What We Offer

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

* Flexible hybrid work model (São Paulo/Home Office).

* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in the fast-growing Retail Media sector.

* A collaborative, international environment with real growth opportunities.

title: Coordenador (A) De Inteligência De Mercado
description:
Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.


Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador (a) de Inteligência de Mercado para fazer parte do nosso time!


Responsável por coordenar e estruturar atividades relacionadas à área de inteligência de mercado, envolvendo análise de dados sobre concorrência, consumidores, tendências e cenários, com o objetivo de ser um elo estratégico entre os dados analíticos e as áreas de negócio, principalmente as áreas de Trade Marketing, comercial e Planejamento Estratégico.

A posição combina capacidade analítica sólida com visão estratégica e habilidade de influência, sendo peça-chave para elevar a maturidade e a relevância da área na organização.

Responsável pelos processos de mapeamento e acompanhamento de mercado e concorrentes, comportamentos e tendências pelas segmentações dos canais analisando os pontos fortes e fraquezas e principalmente movimentos dos concorrentes e tendências do setor e do mercado de energia.

Construção de cenários e identificação de oportunidades de negócios, com o objetivo de gerar insights relevantes e estratégicos para a área Comercial com o objetivo de reconquistar clientes e alcançar os resultados da Companhia.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Relacionamento com clientes internos: ser uma peça-chave e ponto de contato principal com as equipes comerciais para trazer insights que agreguem valor a estratégia comercial contribuindo com a estratégia da Companhia em aumento das vendas e melhor resultado da empresa;
  • Compreender as necessidades das áreas e traduzir em demandas analíticas claras para o time;
  • Apresentar resultados e recomendações com clareza e assertividade para públicos variados;
  • Construir relações de confiança que posicionem a área como parceira estratégica do negócio;
  • Gestão do time: Coordenar a rotina dos analistas, garantindo qualidade, prazos e evolução técnica da equipe, distribuir e priorizar demandas apoiar o desenvolvimento individual dos analistas;
  • Inteligência e análise de mercado: Supervisionar a produção de análises de mercado, cenários competitivos e monitoramento de players, garantir rigor metodológico nas análises produzidas pelo time;
  • Identificar tendências regulatórias, concorrenciais e de demanda no setor de energia;
  • Estruturação e processos: contribuir para evolução da governança da área com melhora de processos e metodologia, apoiar a gestor (a) na conexão da área com a visão estratégica da Companhia.


Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Estatística e afins;
  • Experiência prévia em áreas correlacionadas ao comercial, análise de mercado, business intelligence, estratégia ou consultorias;
  • Capacidade analítica sólida: interpretação de dados, cenários e métricas de mercado associados ao negócio;
  • Habilidade de síntese: transformar análises complexas em documentos executivos e apresentações.


Desejável:


  • Conhecimentos em linguagem SQL;
  • Power BI;
  • Domínio de Python e Azure Databricks;

title: Marketing Coordinator/Specialist
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator/Specialist who will be responsible to lead high-impact growth projects with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. This role blends quantitative rigor, qualitative judgment, and creativity in a project-based environment where no two days look the same. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to grow rapidly by solving meaningful business challenges. You will partner closely with the Marketing Lead on high-priority initiatives and be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Responsibilities:

  • Growth Strategy: Partner with the Marketing Lead to structure complex business challenges into components, develop and validate hypotheses with data, and shape solutions with justifiable ROI.
  • Project Management: Independently scope, plan, and execute multiple concurrent projects end-to-end, leading cross-functional teams and owning the final outcomes.
  • Performance Analysis: Assess project effectiveness and ROI to inform future decisions, optimize resource allocation, and improve marketing efficiency.
  • Player & Product Insight: Build a deep understanding of the game and players.


Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance marketing, with a track record of initiating and driving projects end-to-end. Candidates with non-marketing backgrounds and/or fewer than 3 years of experience will be considered, provided strong transferable experience from the following environments (e.G., MBB, BB IB, PE, VC, or high-growth startups).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and workflows effectively, including AI-enabled automation, agent-based ways of working, etc.
  • Passion for Gaming: Active gamer with a genuine interest in gaming culture and content.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken.
  • Tools: Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, and structured data handling.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

Working Conditions

title: Gerente De Marketing
description:
SOBRE NÓS

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, está chegando ao Brasil.

Iniciamos oficialmente nossas operações com o lançamento da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda. e já estamos totalmente licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming. Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas, como BingoPlus e ArenaPlus, para criar novas oportunidades e experiências empolgantes para os usuários brasileiros.


Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa jornada de inovação e entretenimento.


SOBRE A VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) Marketing Manager para liderar a execução e otimização das estratégias de marketing local no Brasil. Essa posição terá papel fundamental na aquisição de usuários e no fortalecimento da marca BingoPlus no mercado brasileiro.

Você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias em canais-chave, incluindo parcerias com afiliados, colaboração com KOLs/influenciadores, redes sociais (com forte foco em mídia digital) e iniciativas de mídia paga. A função também envolve a gestão de contas oficiais da marca e o desenvolvimento de parcerias com outras indústrias, ampliando a presença e o alcance da marca.

Essa é uma posição hands-on, ideal para alguém que combine visão estratégica com forte capacidade de execução, e que tenha experiência com marketing de performance e iniciativas de crescimento em um ambiente digital dinâmico.


Necessário inglês avançado ou fluente para interação com o time global.


Contrato Presencial em Recife/PE.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias gerais de aquisição de novos usuários, incluindo planos por canal, estratégias de marca, parcerias com KOLs/influenciadores, planejamento de orçamento e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Compreender o perfil dos influenciadores e das principais audiências nas redes sociais no mercado brasileiro, impulsionando colaborações com KOLs alinhadas à marca BingoPlus, gerando tráfego e visibilidade por meio de conteúdo.
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em marketing de afiliados no mercado brasileiro, sendo responsável pela criação, gestão e relacionamento com parceiros afiliados.
  • Atuar em iniciativas de mídia paga, colaborando com o time global de tráfego da Digiplus para implementar estratégias localizadas de aquisição de usuários e contribuir com recomendações estratégicas.
  • Contribuir com ideias e estratégias para a gestão das redes sociais oficiais, criando conteúdos atrativos e estruturando um modelo consistente de operação dos canais.
  • Planejar e executar colaborações com outras indústrias de forma criativa e proativa, ampliando o alcance e posicionamento da marca.
  • Executar a estratégia de marketing alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de marketing em canais online e offline.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das campanhas, garantindo eficiência e melhoria contínua de ROI.
  • Apoiar na gestão do orçamento de marketing, sugerindo alocações eficientes entre canais.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento do usuário e ações da concorrência.
  • Colaborar com Produto, Operações e Compliance para garantir campanhas alinhadas às diretrizes do negócio e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos com análises e recomendações de melhoria.


PROCURAMOS ALGUÉM QUE TENHA

  • Entre 4 e 6 anos de experiência em marketing digital, iGaming ou entretenimento online.
  • Experiência em marketing digital com foco em aquisição de usuários (growth/performance) ;
  • Vivência com mídia paga, afiliados, influenciadores/KOLs e redes sociais ;
  • Conhecimento emgestão de campanhas, orçamento e otimização de ROI ;
  • Experiência em marketing de afiliados e parcerias;
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a dados e resultados;
  • Boa comunicaçãoe capacidade de atuação com diferentes áreas;
  • Perfil hands-on, organizado e com senso de prioridade;
  • Inglêsavançado ou fluente é altamente desejável.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Recife/PE.


SERÁ UM DIFERENCIAL SE VOCÊ TIVER


  • Vivência em empresas internacionais ou times globais


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ
  • Reembolso de despesa parcial ou integral de plano de saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico para você e seus dependentes;

title: Senior Quality Assurance (Qa) Engineer
description:
Responsável por planejar, desenvolver e executar a estratégia de testes técnicos e funcionais para garantir a integridade dos dados e a excelência em sistemas de alta transação. O desafio envolve a validação End-to-End (E2E) de jornadas complexas que integram sistemas centrais de loteria, portais web, aplicativos móveis e terminais físicos, assegurando que cada transação lotérica e financeira ocorra com precisão matemática, segurança e desempenho sob carga.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

· Estratégia de Testes E2E: Projetar e implementar planos de testes de ponta a ponta em ecossistemas complexos.

· Automação de Testes: Desenvolver e manter frameworks de automação (API, Web e Mobile) dentro de pipelines de CI/CD.

· Testes de Sistemas Transacionais: Validar fluxos de geração de bilhetes, cálculo de prêmios e integração com gateways de pagamento.

· Testes de Performance e Carga: Executar testes de estresse para garantir que a plataforma suporte picos de tráfego.

· Validação de Conformidade: Garantir que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos regulatórios do setor de loterias e aos padrões de segurança (PCI-DSS, LGPD/GDPR, ISO 27001).

· Gestão de Defeitos: Identificar, documentar e acompanhar bugs complexos, colaborando com as equipes de Engenharia e Produto.

· Garantia da Qualidade de Dados: Realizar testes técnicos em banco de dados para validar a integridade de dados financeiros e sensíveis.

· Qualidade e Governança: Cumprir as diretrizes das normas ISO 9001 e ISO 27001, políticas de Jogo Responsável e assegurar a confidencialidade das informações organizacionais.

title: Sao Paulo/Bogota - Hybrid - L2 Soc Analyst
description:
About the Company:

As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.


We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.


Role Overview:

As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC’s detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization’s overall security posture.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
  • Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
  • Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
  • Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews.


2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

  • Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
  • Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
  • Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.


3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development

  • Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
  • Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.


Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
  • Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.G., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
  • Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP).
  • Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
  • A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.


Working conditions:

  • Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo) or Colombia (Bogotá)
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
  • Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
  • Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
  • Fluency in English required

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Company Description
About TOMRA Food:
TOMRA Food is a multi-national organization and a leading provider of sensor based sorting and processing technology for the fresh and processed food industries. Developing state-of-the-art technologies, optimizing customers' production flow, and helping to deliver consistent high quality output have been our strengths for more than 30 years in the food industry. Our US Food division is based in Sacramento, CA. and we are always seeking talented and passionate individuals to join our organization.
At TOMRA, we want people to innovate, exhibit passion in their work and be responsible. We encourage the freedom to innovate and take risks that result in breakthroughs that challenge the status quo. We thrive off passion that always focuses and commits to meeting success. We demand a responsible and safe mindset that takes care of our customers, products and fellow employees.
Job Description
The Field Service Engineer (FSE) plays a key role in delivering high-quality service that enhances machine performance and ensures an exceptional customer experience. Our FSEs are proactive, solutions-focused professionals who take initiative and are accountable for the delivery, installation, and ongoing maintenance of our equipment.
They bring a well-rounded skill set in mechanical, electrical, and computer systems, including equipment operation, assembly, and installation. Their responsibilities span the full service lifecycle—from initial setup through preventive maintenance—ensuring our customers consistently achieve optimal results.
Collaboration is essential in this role. FSEs work closely with both customers and internal teams, promoting safety and reliability while upholding our global standards of excellence.
Operations
  • Ensure that machines are working according to customer expectations.
  • React to machine problems in the field within an appropriate time frame and ensure prompt resolution. When an easy solution is not possible, make sure the customer is well informed about the plan and potential costs.
  • Solves mechanical or operational efficiency problems.
  • Troubleshoot machine and/or performance issues until resolved.
  • Perform preventative maintenance to include pre- and post-season machine maintenance and work to improve the continuous performance of the machines.
  • Complete disassembly and installation of mechanical components such as shafts, bearings, belts, motors.
  • Maintain close relationship with sales leadership by providing updates to customers and advising on potential sales opportunities or customer concerns for follow-up action(s).
  • Actively contributes to continuous improvement activities.
  • Assist with the training and development of new Field Service Engineers as requested.
Customer service
  • Address or escalate customer complaints;
    ensure these are investigated or resolved, where possible, in a timely, clear and professional manner.
  • Work proactively with customers and internal stakeholders to successfully complete projects (eg, testing, retrofits, retrofits, or R&D site upgrades).
  • Conduct customer training, as required.
Qualifications
  • Preferred background: Technical or Engineering degree in Automation and Robotics, Mechatronics, Industrial Electricity, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.
  • 0-2 years of experience.
  • Must have class B driver's license.
  • Able to see electromechanical topics.
  • SEC A or B electrical installer license, not exclusive but desirable.
  • English at least at an intermediate level to have a communicative conversation.
  • Ability to interpret manuals, electrical, electronic and other diagrams.
  • Orientation towards the external client, good problem-solving capacity, analytical skills and ability to work under pressure, good communication skills.
  • Availability to relocate and travel frequently.
Additional Information
  • Ability to bend, kneel, and stand frequently, and work in confined spaces.
  • Capacity to work under pressure.
  • Ability to lift up to 20 kilos, on a regular basis.
  • Ability to distinguish between the full range of colors in the color spectrum
  • Ability to work in food processing plants, farms, cold storage facilities, and outdoors in high or low temperatures.
  • Must be able to drive without restrictions and possess a valid driver's license.
  • Not have significant food allergies that impede the ability to work around or near food, nuts, fruits, and vegetables.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively and must be able to obtain a valid passport to travel
Benefits
You will have long-term career opportunities, with a globally renowned company and the following:
  • Parental Leave (up to 8 weeks according to internal policy)
  • Referral and Jubilee bonus
  • Professional Training and Development
  • Global Career Opportunities with strong record for internal promotions

title: Sdr | Prospecção Ativa + Atendimento Inbound
description:
Este SDR atua nas duas frentes: atende leads que chegam via campanhas digitais (inbound) e também prospecta ativamente novos clientes no mercado (outbound). É o profissional que abre portas — e mantém o funil cheio todos os dias

Atividades:


Atendimento de Leads Digitais

  • Atender com agilidade leads que chegam via Google Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn e site
  • Fazer o primeiro contato por ligação em até 1 hora após a conversão
  • Qualificar o lead: identificar perfil, dor, urgência e fit com as soluções da ATS
  • Enviar e-mail e WhatsApp de apresentação e follow-up personalizado
  • Registrar todas as interações no CRM e agendar reuniões para o time de Closers

Prospecção Ativa

  • Montar listas de prospecção com empresas dentro do perfil ideal de cliente (ICP)
  • Abordar decisores via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, cold call e cold e-mail
  • Executar cadências multicanal: e-mail + ligação + WhatsApp + LinkedIn
  • Criar o interesse e gerar reuniões qualificadas mesmo com leads que nunca ouviram falar da ATS
  • Personalizar abordagens por segmento, porte e dor específica de cada empresa

Gestão de Processo

  • Manter o CRM 100% atualizado — histórico, status e próximos passos de cada lead
  • Cumprir metas diárias e semanais de contatos, cadências e agendamentos
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e treinamentos com o time comercial
  • Contribuir com feedbacks do mercado para ajustar discurso e ICP


Perfil Comportamental — Quem tem sucesso nessa cadeira

Usamos o modelo DISC para entender quem performa melhor. Para essa vaga, buscamos predominância I + D: comunicativo, persuasivo, direto e orientado a resultado.


I — Influência (perfil base)

Cria rapport rápido, é natural no contato, convence sem pressionar. Essencial para abrir portas.

✅ Resiliência: Recebe 'não' e volta mais forte. Não desanima com cadência e rejeição.

✅ Coachability: Absorve feedback e ajusta o discurso rapidamente. Aprende sem ego.

✅ Senso de dono: Trata o pipeline como seu negócio. Não espera mandar — age.


D — Dominância (traço necessário)

Direto, sem enrolação. Age com urgência e não deixa o lead esfriar.

✅ Disciplina: Executa volume todos os dias. Cadência sem disciplina não existe.

✅ Curiosidade investigativa: Apura dores do prospect. Não segue script cegamente — pensa junto.

✅ Comunicação adaptável: Muda o tom conforme o canal: formal no e-mail, direto na ligação.


Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo (superior em andamento é diferencial)
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita — ligação, e-mail e WhatsApp
  • Capacidade de lidar com objeções e manter cadência de contatos
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (e-mail, LinkedIn, WhatsApp Business)


Diferenciais (não obrigatório)

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, BDR, televendas ou prospecção B2B
  • Uso de CRM (Kommo, RD Station, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator ou ferramentas de prospecção
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em automação, IA ou tecnologia B2B
  • Familiaridade com cadências multicanal e técnicas de cold call / cold e-mail


O que oferecemos

  • Salário fixo + comissão por agendamento qualificado e conversão
  • Treinamento completo: produto, ICP, discurso, objeções e ferramentas
  • Leads inbound chegando todo dia + suporte para prospecção ativa
  • Produto relevante: automação e IA são as maiores demandas do mercado agora
  • Time jovem, dinâmico e com cultura de resultado
  • Crescimento real: SDR com performance tem trilha direta para Closer ou Executivo Comercial
  • Regime — CLT

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.


Comprometida com a sustentabilidade, a Hyundai iniciou medidas para liderar uma era de mobilidade mais sustentável eletrificando sua linha de produtos e expandindo seus negócios de hidrogênio para veículos comerciais e dispositivos de utilidade. A Hyundai Motor Brasil começou suas operações em 2012, introduzindo o modelo único HB20 no mercado local, projetado e desenvolvido especificamente para o país. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.


Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade;
este é o nosso DNA Hyundai;
este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.

description:
A VERX é uma consultoria especializada em TI, apaixonada por desafios e comprometida em impulsionar transformações tecnológicas estratégicas para nossos clientes. Se você busca crescimento profissional e deseja atuar em projetos inovadores, essa oportunidade é para você.


Buscamos alguém que:

Tenha atuação em Gestão de Identidades e Acessos (IAM), com foco em redução de riscos, governança e evolução de maturidade em segurança.


Responsabilidades:

- Operar e evoluir soluções de IAM, garantindo o ciclo completo de vida das identidades (JML – Joiner, Mover, Leaver);

- Assegurar o princípio do menor privilégio (Least Privilege) em todos os acessos;

- Conduzir iniciativas de governança de Active Directory, reduzindo riscos e acessos privilegiados;

- Implementar e evoluir controles como segregação de contas e modelo de tiers (Tier 0, 1 e 2);

- Gerenciar contas de serviço, promovendo práticas seguras como rotação de credenciais e uso de identidades gerenciadas (gMSA);

- Atuar na higienização de identidades, eliminando contas inativas, órfãs ou com riscos de segurança;

- Garantir a gestão de acessos privilegiados via PAM, incluindo cofre de senhas, sessões monitoradas e acesso Just-in-Time (JIT);

- Automatizar processos de provisionamento e governança, reduzindo riscos operacionais;

- Implementar controles de segurança by design em fluxos automatizados;

- Apoiar auditorias e garantir conformidade com normas e regulamentações (LGPD, ISO 27001, CIS Controls);

- Criar e acompanhar indicadores de risco e maturidade em segurança de identidade.


O que você precisa dominar:

- Active Directory (AD DS, GPO, Hardening);

- Soluções de PAM(CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea ou similares);

- IAM / IGA;

- Automação (scripts, APIs, workflows);

- Ferramentas de governança de identidade.


Requisitos:

- Residir em São Paulo;

- Ter fácil acesso a região da zona sul da cidade, Pinheiros;

- Disponibilidadepara atuar 3x na semana no cliente;

- Experiência comprovada na área.


Diferenciais que valorizamos:

- Modelos Zero Trust

- Segurança de identidade em ambientes híbridos (on-prem + cloud)

- Conceitos e aplicações de Inteligência Artificial (ex: Lovable, Claude).


Modalidade de Contratação : PJ

Inicio : Imediata

Modalidade : Híbrido, zona sul de São Paulo I 3x no cliente.

title: Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist
description:
Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist


Overview

The Specialist, Information Security - Forensics is part of a global team and is responsible for incident response of cyber security incidents that are associated with our businesses, clients, and vendors;
is technically skilled and ensures incident containment, remediation, and closure. This individual will be expected to work closely with the legal, data privacy, business, and client teams. They should be comfortable with interacting with senior executives, including C-level staff.


Responsibilities:

Incident Leadership

  • Serve as the Incident Commander, leading the full lifecycle of cybersecurity incident investigations and response efforts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional communication during high-severity incidents, ensuring rapid containment and clarity across teams.
  • Present concise, accurate written and oral reports to executive and operational leadership.

Forensic Analysis & Investigation

  • Analyze compromised or potentially compromised systems using advanced forensic tools and methodologies.
  • Conduct complex forensic investigations into system breaches, data leaks, and architectural weaknesses.
  • Coordinate evidence and data collection to ensure thorough and reliable incident documentation.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare detailed security incident reports that transform technical findings into actionable insights for decision-makers.
  • Document investigation steps, timelines, technical observations, and remediation impacts with precision and clarity.

Threat Intelligence & Continuous Learning

  • Maintain current knowledge of attacker TTPs, advanced persistent threats, emerging tools, and incident response best practices.
  • Apply threat intelligence insights to strengthen investigative techniques and enhance incident detection capabilities.

Technical Guidance & Support

  • Provide expert technical guidance to teams on incident monitoring, triage, response workflows, threat and vulnerability management, and security analysis.
  • Mentor team members and support growth in incident response competencies across the organization.

Process Optimization & Strategic Direction

  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve incident management efficiency and response workflows at scale.
  • Champion the integration of automation and AI-driven tools to accelerate detection, triage, and resolution.
  • Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of the company’s cybersecurity and incident response programs.


Qualifications:

  • EDR Experience- CrowdStrike and/or SentinelOne with experience investigating and analyzing malware and other malicious activity.
  • Experience with forensics tools such as FTK, EnCase, Autopsy to collect and analyze file system artifacts, process history, application artifacts, memory collection and analysis for physical and cloud systems (Windows, Mac, Linux).
  • 4 or more years of experience in an analytical role of either forensics analyst (Linux, Windows, or MacOS), threat analyst, incident response, SOC analyst, or security engineer/ consultant.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as: Azure, AWS, GCP – knowing how to collect and analyze logs from Guard Duty/ Defender and CloudTrail, etc.
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK or related frameworks.
  • Experience developing and managing incident response programs with focus on efficiency through AI development.
  • Strong communication skills with confidence leading Incident Response calls with different stakeholders;
    followed by producing detailed incident reports.
  • Proficient insocial engineering, phishing, and related fraud schemes.
  • Strong general knowledge of security concepts and expertise in network and web application security issue s.
  • Experience with a scripting language such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or other scripting language in an incident handling environment.

title: Lifecycle And Events Marketing Coordinator
description:
About Us

Oxford University Press (OUP), a department of the University of Oxford, has supported education and research for more than 500 years. From supporting children learning to read to advancing global research, our mission is to create the highest quality educational and research resources and make them available worldwide.

Our English Language Teaching (ELT) business in Brazil continues to grow, and we are looking for a Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator to join our Brazil Marketing team.


About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for a customer-focused and well-organised marketing professional to play a central role in coordinating and delivering marketing activity across Brazil.

The purpose of this role is to coordinate and execute Brazil’s marketing plan, ensuring all activities are shaped by local customer needs and contribute to country revenue growth. The role combines marketing planning, events, campaigns, communications, localisation, and customer lifecycle activity, working closely with Sales, Customer Enablement and Operations.

Reporting to the Managing Director, the Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator will ensure that marketing activity is relevant, well-executed and effectively supports customer engagement across the entire lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the annual Brazil marketing planning process, consolidating inputs, timelines and customer insights
  • Deliver high-quality events, campaigns and communications, ensuring strong execution, participation and effective follow-up
  • Manage the localisation and creation of Brazil-relevant marketing materials, adapting global assets and developing local content as needed
  • Provide the Sales team with timely, accurate and Brazil-relevant materials, information and messaging to support customer conversations
  • Apply customer lifecycle principles across acquisition, onboarding, in-life engagement and renewal, creating or adapting communications where required
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment, clear communication and effective execution of marketing activities
  • Track performance, capture learning and continuously improve marketing effectiveness and customer experience
  • Use marketing and sales tools (including Salesforce, HighSpot, Dotdigital, Eventbrite and Google tools) to plan, deliver and evaluate activities


About You

We are looking for a proactive, collaborative professional who combines strong organisational skills with a clear focus on customer needs and high-quality execution.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Strong customer focus and understanding of the needs of schools, educators and institutions in Brazil
  • Experience coordinating and delivering marketing plans, events, campaigns and communications
  • Ability to adapt global marketing assets and create clear, on-brand and locally relevant materials
  • Experience supporting sales teams with timely, accurate and customer-relevant resources
  • Practical understanding of customer lifecycle stages (acquisition, onboarding, in-life, renewal)
  • Comfortable using marketing and sales platforms and tools to plan, deliver and track activity
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English

Desirable:

  • Knowledge of the Brazilian education and ELT market
  • Experience in B2B and/or education-sector marketing
  • Experience coordinating vendors or event logistics
  • Experience working with global teams or adapting global frameworks to local markets


Why Join Oxford University Press?

At OUPB, you will be part of a purpose-driven organisation with a global mission and local impact. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities for learning and development, and the chance to shape meaningful marketing activity that supports education across Brazil.

Apply now and help us support learners and educators across Brazil.


GJC Level: I6 (for internal purposes only)

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Sap Grc Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema


Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.


Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.


In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.


Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.


What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Freelance Community Manager
description:
Position Summary

This individual will play a critical role in managing and nurturing clients' social media communities, building authentic connections with audiences while maintaining the brand’s voice and identity across various digital platforms. In addition to overseeing community management, the Community Manager will support more senior team members with key social media strategy tasks, including social listening, consumer insight mining, trend reporting, and monthly performance reporting.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day community engagement across multiple social media platforms, ensuring timely and authentic responses to user comments, messages, and interactions.
  • Monitor and engage with brand mentions, keywords, and hashtags to foster conversations, address concerns, and strengthen community relationships.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, social media platform updates, and best practices to continuously improve community engagement efforts.
  • Assist in the creation and implementation of social media strategies with senior team members.
  • Conduct social listening to identify relevant trends, monitor competitor activity, and uncover consumer sentiment and insights.
  • Gather and analyze consumer feedback, social sentiment, and brand engagement data to inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Contribute to the preparation and execution of social media campaigns, ensuring they align with the brand's goals and messaging.
  • Assist with monthly performance reports, including highlighting key metrics such as engagement rates, audience growth, and content performance.


Other Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in brainstorming and contributing to the development of social content calendars.
  • Participate in cross-functional team meetings to align on key deliverables and ensure cohesive execution of social media strategies.


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • 2-3+ years of experience in social media management, community management, or digital marketing, preferably in an agency setting.
  • Deep understanding of social media platforms, community building, and best practices.
  • Experience in using social media management tools, such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or similar.
  • Ability to analyze social media metrics and provide actionable insights for campaign optimization.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with an ability to adapt tone and style for different brands and audiences.


Compensation

  • This is a contract role with the option to work up to 6 months. The base salary range for this role at the time of posting is R$7,500 to R$8,000/month. The salary an employee or prospective employee is paid within this range will depend on factors such as but not limited to: internal compensation of current employees in similar roles, market considerations, budgetary considerations, level of responsibility, background, experience, and qualifications.


This is a remote position. Considering PJ contractors based around or near Curitiba, Brazil.

description:

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Você atuará em uma empresa do segmento de Agronegócio , que está estruturando uma nova área de tecnologia, com forte foco em SAP S/4HANA , processos críticos de negócio e transformação digital.

  • Executar testes manuais e apoiar na evolução de automações
  • Validar fluxos de negócio (originação de grãos, logística e financeiro) garantindo qualidade das entregas
  • Atuar em testes funcionais, integrados (SIT) e de aceitação (UAT)
  • Identificar, registrar e acompanhar bugs
  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar na organização de evidências e documentação de testes


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com processos de QA (planejamento, execução e gestão de bugs)
  • Vivência com testes manuais e automatizados, com contato em automação de testes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex.: Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, CBTA ou similares)
  • Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Newman, Rest Assured, Swagger ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de teste (SIT, UAT e Regressão)
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de testes (Jira, SAP Cloud ALM, Azure DevOps ou similares)


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com automação utilizando Python (Pytest, Robot Framework).
  • Familiaridade com uso de IA no desenvolvimento de testes (GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
  • Conhecimento em módulos SAP (ACM, SD, MM, FI, TM).
  • Vivência com metodologia SAP Activate.
  • Experiência no setor de Agronegócio ou Logística Multimodal será considerada um diferencial.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Presencial

description:

Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Elaborar e gerenciar o plano de testes cobrindo testes de integração, regressão e UAT para todos os fluxos de transação.

title: Segment Manager - Pv
description:
The Position:

As a core operator of the "Segment Penetration" strategy in the Latam region, the Segment Manager - PV will be primarily responsible for market insights, strategy formulation, competitive response, opportunity management, and capability building within the assigned segment (PV). Serving as a critical link between headquarters strategy and regional execution, this role carries the dual mission of strategic interpretation and tactical implementation, translating headquarters’ segment strategy into actionable plans, empowering country teams for execution, and fostering cross-regional collaboration to achieve synergistic outcomes.


Main activities and Responsibilities:

  • Strategy and Market Insight: Conduct in-depth analysis of policies, markets, customers, and competitors in target Latam countries. Identify segment-specific opportunities and regularly produce market analysis reports to inform segment planning and decision-making.
  • Product and Competitive Strategy: Actively participate in the formulation and review of segment product strategies, drive product optimization and standardization, and monitor strategy execution to ensure a closed-loop management process. Lead the development of segment competitive strategies, produce competitor analysis reports, and dynamically refine competitive positioning in direct sales scenarios. In channel scenarios, analyze and increase the proportion of top-tier channel partners while providing strategic support for key projects.
  • Pricing and Profitability Management: Conduct regular in-depth analysis of market pricing and competitors to support pricing strategy development. Participate in the annual product pricing strategy formulation and dynamically manage pricing execution to balance competitiveness and profitability goals.
  • Opportunity Coordination and Solution Management: Oversee segment-level opportunity management by integrating leads across countries, optimizing allocation mechanisms, and producing management reports. Promote the standardized implementation of processes at the country level. Develop and refine benchmark scenario solutions for key Latam markets, creating replicable case studies. Drive agile innovation and localization adaptation across the "Headquarters-Region-Country" three-tier structure.
  • Empowerment and Collaborative Operations: Serve as a segment expert, proactively providing strategic guidance, solution support, and project collaboration to country teams. Integrate regional resources to facilitate breakthroughs in critical projects.


Qualifications and basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Energy, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Proficient in English as a working language, with excellent cross-cultural communication skills.
  • Spanish knowledge is a plus


Experience and Competencies

  • Industry Experience: Experience in marketing, strategic planning, product management, or solution sales within the PV, ESS, or related industries.
  • Regional Experience: Familiarity with multiple key markets in the Latam region. Candidates with local business insights and networks are preferred.
  • Professional Expertise: Practical experience in at least three of the following areas: market insight, product/competitive strategy, pricing/opportunity management, capability building/system establishment.
  • Core Skills: Strong market analysis, data interpretation, and strategic planning abilities. Capable of independently producing high-quality strategic reports and skilled in methodology summarization and team empowerment.


Key Attributes

  • Resilience and Self-Drive: Ability to embrace change and challenges in a fast-paced international business environment, demonstrating a strong sense of responsibility and intrinsic motivation to proactively seek breakthroughs.
  • Core Qualities: Exceptional influencing and persuasion skills, teamwork spirit, customer-centric mindset, and a results-oriented approach.


Work Location and Status:

  • Vila Olímpia - São Paulo/SP
  • Availability to travels.


Compensation:

  • Compensation commensurate with experience
  • Competitive benefits package
  • Strong personal and company growth opportunities

  • Engineering degree or confirmed technician background in mechanics or electricity/automation;
    knowledge of construction/civil works is a plus.

  • Strong technical expertise in mechanics/electricity;
    proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office.

  • Flexibility, resilience, and autonomy under remote management (Europe-based).

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).


Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.


Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.


How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Sap S/4hana Security & Authorisation Manager
description:
SAP S/4HANA Security and Authorisation Manager | Digital Core

Locations: Sao Paolo, Brazil - Hyderabad, India


As we work to transform and optimise Mars, a new program has been mobilised by the Mars leadership team. The program is focused on the design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA in Mars across Segments (Petcare, Corporate, Snacking & Food). Much more than a simple “Lift and Shift,” this program will undertake a major process simplification and harmonisation scope as we digitally transform our business.

The program focuses primarily on eight mega process areas: Finance, Source to Pay (procurement and vendor mgmt.), Plan to Fulfil (manufacturing and distribution), Lead to Cash (sales order processing and payment), Governance, Engage to Consume (marketing), Idea to Market (R&D), and Recruit to Retire (HR). This transformation requires thought leadership, quality decision making, deep technical know-how, and an ability to navigate complex business challenges while applying a holistic and multi-disciplinary approach to each of these mega processes.

As part of the program, four new positions have been created to manage all core Security and Compliance activities related to the SAP S/4HANA landscape.

Collectively the new roles will be responsible for the delivery of the core SAP Security deliverables within S/4HANA and FIORI ensuring alignment with role design, processes and governance principles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. personally and within the team.
  • Support the SAP Security team in ensuring that shared and local / segment template security requirements are adopted across business segments while incorporating segment-specific needs into the shared template or localising them as necessary.
  • Analyse and understand the security requirements and risks of a complex ERP environment that underpins critical business and IT processes.
  • Work with the SAP Security team and Global Process Owners (GPO’s) in implementing a comprehensive SAP Security and GRC framework, including strategies, policies, and procedures that align with organisational objectives and industry best practices to ensure robust access controls, risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and deliver technical and functional solutions against specifications in accordance with agreed standards and procedures.
  • Follow standards and procedure for user provisioning, de-provisioning, and segregation of duties.
  • Lead and support multiple testing phases – including build unit tests (BUT) security unit tests (SUT) system integration tests (SIT) and user acceptance tests (UAT) by leveraging Mars current test tools to ensure robust SAP security and system integrity.
  • Collaborate effectively within a diverse team that fosters an inclusive culture, ensuring all contributions are valued and recognised.
  • Stay informed on emerging security threats and apply industry best practices to strengthen SAP application security and controls.


Context and Scope

Programs are often marked by a seamless transition from the old system/landscape to the new one. As part of this SAP S/4HANA Digital Transformation program, we require someone with high-level expertise and experience in SAP Security & Authorisations in S/4HANA including FIORI.

The successful candidate will support the delivery of the security scope and collaborate with counterparts at Mars (i.E. Petcare, Corporate, Snacking and Food) to capture and analyse authorisation requirements and security related activities.



Education and Professional

  • 10+ years in SAP Security and Authorisations with at least three full life cycle implementations in S/4HANA and FIORI.
  • Professional certification such as SAP Certified Technology Professional, SAP Access Control 12.0, or other relevant security certifications.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Possess deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA security and authorisations including role design administration and integration with FIORI.
  • Proficiency in security design, configuration, testing and deployment across key technologies including SAP S/4HANA, Fiori and SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).
  • Strong understanding of authorisation concepts for S/4 HANA including FIORI, Business Technology Platform (BTP) and other Cloud applications such SuccessFactors, Ariba, & SAP MDG.
  • Deep knowledge of SOX compliance, segregation of duties (SoD), GDPR, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent understanding of S/4HANA product roadmap.
  • Highly organised with proven experience in setting and managing deadlines across diverse stakeholder groups while ensuring clear ownership and accountability for all activities.
  • Demonstrates a strong team player mindset with a drive to develop new professional skills combined with proactive, growth oriented and goal-focused approach to work.
  • Excellent documentation, visualisation and presentation skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft office tools particularly PowerPoint and Excel with expertise in building complex formulas, developing pivot tables and creating data-driven reports and presentations.
  • Experience working with System and Business Integrators.
  • Ability to work under pressure and maintain a professional manner.


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.
