title: Latam Marketing Manager
description:
BSI’s Assurance division is hiring a LATAM Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy across Latin America with a primary focus on Mexico.

In this role, you will translate global strategy into high-impact, localized programs that fuel pipeline and revenue across System Certification, Training, and ISA, while leading our regional Center of Excellence (CoE) for campaign development, design, and digital execution.

You’ll also serve regionally as a Theme Lead for Quality & Mobility, setting the bar for messaging and integrated campaigns used across the Americas.

If you thrive in a matrixed, fast-paced environment and can flex from strategy to hands-on execution, this role is for you!


What you’ll own:

  • LatAm GTM leadership: Build and deliver the marketing plan for Latin America (with Mexico emphasis) aligned to commercial targets and sector priorities.
  • Localization that wins: Adapt global/regional campaigns to local language, culture, regulation, and buyer behavior.
  • Partner with the business: Collaborate effectively with Sales and Training to shape marketing strategies that move pipeline and revenue.


How you’ll lead:

  • Operational excellence: Drive clarity, workload management, and accountability using project tools (e.G., Workfront);
    uphold brand, compliance, and governance standards.


How you’ll execute:

  • Full-funnel, integrated campaigns: Orchestrate email, web, SEO/SEM, paid media, social, events/webinars, and ABM to create demand and accelerate conversions.
  • Digital & demand-gen mastery: Increase engagement, improve targeting, and optimize journeys;
    manage lead workflows in Salesforce and Pardot (segmentation, routing, nurture).
  • Budget ownership: Plan, allocate, and track the LATAM marketing budget for maximum ROI.
  • Vendor leadership: Manage local partners (design, translation, event logistics, media buying) to deliver on brief, on brand, on budget.
  • Brand & governance: Ensure every asset meets BSI’s standards and regional regulatory requirements.


How you’ll measure success:

  • Performance & analytics: Track KPIs and attribution, maintain CRM hygiene, and partner with data teams on ROI reporting.
  • Optimize in real time: Use funnel insights to test, learn, and iterate maximizing conversion and marketing-influenced revenue.


Regional Theme Leadership (Quality & Mobility):

  • Set the bar regionally: Define positioning, content strategy, and integrated campaigns for Quality & Mobility.
  • Scale best practices: Align global messaging with LATAM needs;
    enable knowledge-sharing and consistent activation across countries.


What you bring:

  • Strategic clarity & executional rigor: You turn business goals into actionable programs that deliver measurable impact.
  • Proven demand gen: History of campaigns that drive MQLs, pipeline, and conversion in complex B2B environments.
  • LATAM expertise: Deep understanding of Mexico and broader LATAM buyer behavior, channels, and regulatory nuances.
  • Localization mastery: You have experience in tailoring global content/messages for maximum regional relevance.
  • Relationship builder: Confident collaborator across Sales, Training, and global teams.
  • Operational savvy: Budget management, vendor oversight, and performance reporting are second nature.
  • Martech fluency: Hands-on with Salesforce and Pardot (required);
    familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, SEO/SEM, paid media, and ABM tactics.
  • Organized & adaptable: Comfortable switching from big-picture strategy to precise execution;
    continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Segment & persona chops: You tailor narratives and offers by industry, role, and stage to move deals forward.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 6+ years progressive B2B marketing experience (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries ideal), including 3+ years leading people.
  • Proven experience executing marketing across Mexico and broader LATAM.
  • Success running multi-channel GTM in a complex organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop marketing professionals and foster cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong digital demand gen/ABM background and CRM-led workflows (Salesforce/Pardot required).
  • Familiarity with ISO, assurance, training, or compliance services (preferred).
  • Knowledge of Quality or Mobility sectors (preferred).


Language Requirements

A strong command of English, Spanish, and Portuguese is essential - both verbal and written. Please submit your application in English.


BSI - Your Partner in Progress

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organizations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team then please apply now!


What we offer

BSI offers a competitive salary, 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, vacation bonus, medical insurance, life insurance, savings fund with company contribution, meal allowance, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization — all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA


ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.


About the Job


ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.


This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.


Key Responsibilities


Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development


  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.


Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution


  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.


Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management


  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.


Project Oversight & Value Realization


  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.


What You’ll Need


Experience


  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.


Network & Market Knowledge


  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.


Territory Management


  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.


Languages


  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.


Commercial & Strategic Skills


  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.


Remote Collaboration


  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.


Travel


  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.


Why Join us?


  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.


*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

Lead negotiations on commercial terms and secure new business, working closely with internal teams as needed. title: Product Manager
description:
About Antom & Ant International

Our vision is to provide inclusive and convenient payment and financial solutions for global cross-border consumers and sellers. As part of Ant international product team , you will play a pivotal role in achieving our global vision. We are looking for a dynamic Product Manager to take ownership of enabling extensive payment methods in Brazil for global merchants and delivering superior acquiring solutions to Brazil-based businesses.


The Role

In this position, you will be responsible for ensuring an optimal user experience, higher approval rates, operational efficiency, and strict adherence to security and regulatory standards. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, driving the evolution of our payment ecosystem in Latin America.


Key Responsibilities

  • User & Market Insights: Understand user behavior and mindset through deep-dive research, data mining, observation, and E2E testing.
  • Channel Expansion: Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to expand Brazilian payment channels for global merchants.
  • Integration Management: Lead the E2E transaction flow and manage the integration of payment channels onto the Alipay platform , from contract review to go-live.
  • Merchant Solutions: Identify payment pain points for Brazil-based merchants;
    propose and implement innovative solutions to solve them.
  • Product Excellence: Strengthen foundational product elements, including payment processing, settlement, and merchant services, to enhance competitiveness and user satisfaction.
  • Competitive Analysis: Monitor the Latin American competitive landscape and emerging trends to identify untapped opportunities and unmet needs.
  • Performance Tracking: Define and track key product performance metrics, continuously iterating to improve customer experience.
  • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary product contact and advocate, both internally and externally.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in payment products, with a strong focus on Pix and card payment processing .
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of digital wallets, payment technology, and the Latam fintech ecosystem.
  • Product Design: Proven track record in E2E payment product design and implementation is highly preferred.
  • Technical Savvy: Hands-on experience working with both business and technical teams, translating requirements into clear product specifications.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven decision-making skills and ability to perform competitor analysis and strategic planning.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrix environment that requires high cross-functional collaboration.
  • Global Mindset: Comfortable working across different time zones.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is required.


How to Apply

If you are passionate about the future of global payments and want to make an impact in the Latam market, we want to hear from you!

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
What can you expect?

  • Be part of a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of data engineering and data science.
  • Design and deliver scalable data pipelines, production ML models, and data products that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Work with semi- and unstructured data, including LLMs and NLP techniques.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, senior engineers, and business stakeholders.


What is in it for you?

  • Opportunity for technical and career growth by working end-to-end on ML and data projects.
  • Hands-on experience with ELT/ETL pipelines, modeling, deployment, and production monitoring (MLOps).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and modern ML frameworks.
  • Chance to deliver data products that influence business decisions and results.


We will count on you to:

  • Implement and maintain scalable ELT/ETL data pipelines.
  • Contribute to the development, validation, and deployment of ML models with a focus on reproducible training and CI/CD.
  • Apply MLOps best practices for model packaging, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build and maintain data models and feature stores to ensure data integrity and quality.
  • Deliver data products (APIs, dashboards, notebooks) that translate models and analytics into actionable outcomes.
  • Evaluate performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency of data and ML systems in cloud environments.
  • Define and maintain operational standards, including logging, alerting, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements and success metrics.


What you need to have:

  • Professional experience in data engineering, data science, or ML engineering (including internships).
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Familiarity with unit, integration, and data quality testing.
  • Knowledge of data transformation frameworks (e.G., dbt).
  • Experience with core ML frameworks (e.G., scikit-learn, PyTorch, transformers).
  • Exposure to or strong interest in MLOps concepts (CI/CD for ML, model deployment, production monitoring).
  • Interest in NLP and text-based ML tools (regular expressions, NLTK, spaCy).


What makes you stand out:

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery).
  • Demonstrated experience deploying ML models to production.
  • Prior experience on a data team in technology, consulting, or startup environments.
  • Domain knowledge or strong interest in insurance/reinsurance analytics and risk products.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience with data-labeling frameworks (e.G., LabelStudio).
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT patterns and REST APIs.

title: Consultor Sap Pp

description:
BRAZILIAN PORTUGUESE VERSION


ANALISTA DE SOFTWARE DE PAGAMENTOS


Responsável pela gestão técnica de contas de clientes selecionados no mercado de pagamentos. Definir e acordar a estratégia e os planos táticos para atingir as metas e o crescimento do negócio. RESPONSABILIDADES CHAVE

  • Responder a problemas críticos de suporte para minimizar o impacto nos serviços prestados aos clientes;
    isso inclui análise de problemas de software, comunicação e segurança, com resolução rápida ou soluções alternativas.
  • Realizar solução de problemas avançada em produção;
    isso inclui análise de logs de aplicativos, redes, servidores, roteadores ou bancos de dados para determinar a origem do problema e encaminhá-lo ao grupo apropriado para resolução.
  • Acompanhar o status de problemas de produção/tickets de clientes em aberto e garantir a resolução em tempo hábil.
  • Atualizar os clientes existentes para as versões mais recentes dos pacotes de software dos produtos da empresa.
  • Apoiar o departamento de qualidade, fornecendo análise de problemas e encaminhando-os ao grupo apropriado para resolução.
  • Criar e manter documentação de suporte, como documentação de solução de problemas e instruções de instalação.
  • Ministrar treinamentos sobre os produtos para recursos internos e clientes.
  • Interagir tecnicamente com especialistas de P&D e especialistas dos clientes.
  • Transformar as necessidades de alto nível provenientes de Marketing de Produto, Operações e Vendas em especificações detalhadas, prontas para serem implementadas pelos engenheiros de P&D.
  • Participar de reuniões de sprint com engenheiros de P&D, bem como de outras reuniões ágeis. - Encontrar soluções alternativas para as limitações das tecnologias do produto.
  • Conhecimento em segurança, criptografia e protocolos de cartão será considerado um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em integração de TEF/PDV é um diferencial.


REQUISITOS DE QUALIFICAÇÃO E FORMAÇÃO

  • Necessário conhecimentos em desenvolvimento Android e Windows.
  • Diploma/Universidade: Engenharia ou Ciência da Computação e áreas afins.
  • 5 anos de experiência em funções similares (experiência no setor de Pagamentos, Automação Financeira ou de Varejo)
  • Inglês é um diferencial.


ENGLISH VERSION

Responsible for the technical management of selected customers’ accounts. Define and agree the strategy and tactical plans to achieve the target and growth of the business. Provide technical solutions based on customer requirements focusing on products, services, software and corelated solutions. Introduce and certify new products in the selected accounts.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Respond to critical support issues to minimize service impacts to the customers;
    this includes software,communication and security problem analysis and either quick resolution or workaround solutions.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting for production problems;
    this includes analysis of application, networks, servers, router, or database logs to determine the source of the problem and escalation to the appropriate group for resolution.
  • Track the status of open production issues / customer tickets and ensure timely resolution.
  • Upgrade existing customers to the latest versions of the company’s product software packs.
  • Support the quality department to provide problem analysis and escalation to the appropriate group for resolution.
  • Create and maintain support documentation, such as troubleshooting documentation and installation instructions.
  • Product training for internal resources and customers
  • Technical interface with R&D Specialists and customers experts.
  • Transform high level needs coming from Product Marketing, Operations and Sales into detailed specifications ready to be implemented by R&D engineers.
  • Participate in sprint meetings with R&D Engineers as well as other agile meetings.
  • Find workaround solutions upon product technologies constraints.
  • Knowledge of security, cryptography, and card protocols will be considered a plus.
  • Knowledge in EFT integration is a plus.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Knowledge of Android and Windows development is required.
  • Diploma/University: Computer Engineering or Science and similar
  • 5-year experience in similar functions (experience in the industry of Payments, Financial or Retail Automation)
  • English is a differentiator.

description:
Sobre a vaga


A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?

Especialista de Segurança da Informação


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir avaliações de risco e de ameaças e vulnerabilidades.
  • Avaliar e realizar revisões de configuração de Hardening.
  • Atender e analisar incidentes de segurança (incident Handling), incluindo identificação, investigação, contenção e resolução.
  • Desenvolver, manter e atualizar Playbook de resposta a incidentes.
  • Apoiar o time nas rotinas diárias relacionadas a auditoria interna, compliance etc.
  • Avaliar e analisar os requisitos de segurança para sistemas existentes e novos projetos e regras de Firewall e definir novos requisitos, caso necessário.
  • Responder a chamados e saber analisar risco, troubleshooting em problemas de segurança relacionados a ferramentas, regras e políticas de segurança e regras de firewall.
  • Definição de políticas e realizando revisões de perfis de usuários.
  • Projetar, implementar e manter soluções de segurança, definindo também os processos e controles respectivos.
  • Responder a violações ou ameaças e tomar medidas corretivas e preventivas para evitar futuros incidentes.
  • Monitorar logs internos e tráfego para investigar proativamente atividades suspeitas e anomalias.
  • Comunicar-se com as áreas de os clientes para discutir medidas de segurança e fornecer informações sobre o sistema projetado.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em segurança redes, soluções de proteção cibernética e controles técnicos e operacionais, Sistemas Operacionais, soluções em nuvem.
  • Frameworks e metodologias de segurança, como ISO 27001, NIST e OWASP
  • Conhecimento em conformidades regulatórias como (PCI, SOX)
  • Experiência prática com SOC

  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. cooperativa de crédito;

description:

1. Ferramentas de Segurança

  • Automatizar ações de resposta sempre que possível.
  • Identificar falhas e propor melhorias em ferramentas, processos e tecnologias.
  • Desenvolver e manter base de conhecimento técnico para o time de CyberOps.
  • Gerenciar a operação de monitoramento 24x7.
  • Criar e manter procedimentos operacionais de engenharia de detecção.
  • Participar de exercícios de simulação (tabletop) e testes de incidentes.

  • Gerenciar a operação de detecção e resposta a incidentes.
  • Avaliar a relevância e confiabilidade de indicadores de comprometimento (IOCs) e fontes de inteligência.
  • Integrar inteligência de ameaças ao SIEM e manter conexão com feeds externos e comunidades.
  • Gerenciar a ingestão, curadoria e distribuição de inteligência de ameaças.

EXECUTIVO DE VENDAS INBOUND

B2B | Alta Performance | Sem Teto de Comissão


Você já se perguntou o que separa um vendedor de um profissional que transforma negócios?

Na Midhaus, não buscamos quem apenas vende. Buscamos quem diagnostica, desafia e transforma a realidade dos clientes. A Midhaus não nasceu de uma ideia de negócio. Nasceu de uma convicção: pequenas empresas que crescem geram empregos. E empregos transformam realidades.

Essa é a forma que a gente encontrou de fazer a nossa parte, não reclamando, mas construindo. Antes de oferecer qualquer coisa ao mercado, a gente viveu tudo dentro de casa. O método que você vai conhecer foi testado, validado e ajustado primeiro na nossa própria operação. Só depois passou a ser aplicado nos nossos clientes.

Nosso objetivo é claro: transformar pequenas empresas em grandes negócios. E quando falamos em transformar, estamos falando de construir as alavancas que fazem isso acontecer na prática, porque crescer é, necessariamente, vender mais.

Por isso atuamos nas duas frentes que determinam o crescimento de qualquer empresa: marketing e vendas.

title: Senior Payments Manager – Brazil
description:
Brazil's payment landscape is complex, fast-moving, and full of opportunity and Antom is building the infrastructure to lead it. We're looking for a Senior Payments Manager who thrives at the intersection of relationship management and operational excellence: someone who can navigate Brazil's financial ecosystem with depth and turn strong partnerships into real payment performance.


What you'll do:


Financial institution & payment partner management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for Antom's local payment partners in Brazil, including PIX providers, card acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Maintain and deepen these partnerships to ensure reliability, competitive terms, and long-term strategic alignment.


Payment performance & operations

  • In close collaboration with Antom's internal operations team, monitor and improve SLAs, success rates, and KPIs across local payment methods.
  • Identify performance gaps, coordinate resolution efforts with partners, and drive continuous improvement in payment reliability and conversion.


New payment method onboarding

  • Scout, evaluate, and onboard new local payment methods and financial institution partners that expand Antom's capabilities in Brazil.
  • Lead the end-to-end process from commercial negotiation through to technical go-live.


Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as Antom's internal Brazil payments subject-matter expert, aligning with Product, Tech, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure local solutions are properly integrated and optimized.


Regulatory awareness

  • Stay ahead of Banco Central regulations, PIX rulebook updates, Open Finance developments, and card scheme rules.
  • Translate regulatory changes into actionable internal recommendations and partner discussions.


Market intelligence

  • Continuously map the Brazilian payments landscape — tracking competitor capabilities, emerging payment trends, and new fintech entrants to inform Antom's local strategy.


What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in payments, financial institutions partnerships, or payment operations within a fintech, bank, acquirer, payment processor, or global payments company — with a strong focus on the Brazilian market.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Brazil's payment ecosystem: PIX, card acquiring, and Open Finance, including its regulatory framework and key institutional players.
  • Proven relationship management skills — ability to build and manage senior-level relationships with banks, acquirers, and payment institutions, including navigating complex contractual and operational discussions.
  • Operational mindset — comfortable owning KPIs and SLAs, troubleshooting payment issues with technical and partner teams, and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Cross-functional communication — able to work across commercial, product, tech, and compliance teams, translating between business needs and technical requirements with ease.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency.


Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a global payments company, international acquirer, or cross-border payment platform operating in Brazil.
  • Existing network across Brazilian financial institutions, acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Familiarity with API-based payment integrations and the technical fundamentals of payment processing.
  • A practical approach to AI tools — using them to automate routine tasks, accelerate analysis, and improve the quality and efficiency of your own work output.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Mandarin is a strong plus.



About Antom

Antom is a leading merchant payment and digitisation services provider under Ant International. We help global merchants and partners accept digital payments, scale their businesses across borders, and deliver seamless checkout experiences to consumers worldwide. In Brazil, we are investing in the local payments ecosystem to become the infrastructure layer of choice for merchants operating in or into the market.

title: Regulador De Sinistros Sênior - Riscos Elementares (Re)
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Significa ter flexibilidade e tempo para todas as coisas que são importantes para você. É uma oportunidade de fazer algo significativo todos os dias. É ter apoio para suas necessidades mentais, físicas, financeiras e profissionais. Significa aprimorar suas habilidades e desenvolver sua carreira. E isso significa trabalhar em um ambiente que celebre a diversidade e seja justo e inclusivo.


OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:

  • Atuação em sinistros de Riscos Elementares (RE) – pequeno porte, especialmente em produtos como Residencial, Empresarial Simplificado e Condomínio .
  • Coleta estruturada de informações para viabilizar a continuidade do processo de regulação;
  • Atuação com diferentes linhas de negócio, podendo futuramente atender múltiplas áreas internas da Sedgwick.
  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Direcionamento do processo de vistoria, solicitando aproximações, registros fotográficos e esclarecimentos técnicos conforme o tipo de sinistro;
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.


REQUISITOS

Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.


Experiência

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em posição similar, atuando com regulação de Riscos Elementares (RE) – pequeno porte , especialmente em produtos como Residencial, Empresarial Simplificado e Condomínio.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar bem sob volume elevado, SLAs curtos e demandas simultâneas.
  • Experiência prévia em operações de backoffice, TPA ou seguradoras com carteira massificada será um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.
  • Nível Intermediário – Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel
  • Nível de Inglês Intermediário será considerado diferencial


Habilidades (Pleno) em:

  • Gestão do Tempo
  • Integração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Empatia
  • Habilidade de Comunicação Assertiva
  • Pensamento Analítico
  • Proatividade e postura resolutiva
  • Multitarefa, Organização, Adaptabilidade e Flexibilidade


As declarações contidas neste documento têm como objetivo descrever a natureza geral e o nível do trabalho realizado pelo(a) colaborador(a) designado(a) para esta função. Elas não constituem uma lista exaustiva de responsabilidades, atribuições ou variações regionais. A gestão reserva-se o direito de modificar ou adicionar às atribuições do cargo a qualquer momento, em conformidade com a legislação trabalhista aplicável no Brasil, incluindo a Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho (CLT).

Estamos comprometidos com processos de recrutamento e seleção inclusivos e acessíveis. Caso seja contatado(a) sobre uma oportunidade de emprego, por favor informe à área de Recursos de Colaboradores se precisar de algum tipo de acomodação razoável.

A Sedgwick é uma empregadora que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, em conformidade com a Constituição Federal, a CLT e demais regulamentações aplicáveis no Brasil.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.


Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Work Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Report To : JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader

Business Type : Cross-border Industrial Supply Chain / MRO Industrial Products Procurement & Sales

I. Business Introduction

JD Industrial is the core business segment of JD Group focusing on industrial supply chain technology and services. We have established a localized operation system in Brazil , focusing on providing end-to-end MRO industrial product supply chain solutions for Chinese-funded overseas enterprises and local large-scale manufacturing/energy/infrastructure enterprises.

  • Core Positioning : Serve customers in Brazil's manufacturing, energy, mining, infrastructure and other industries, providing one-stop procurement, cross-border/local fulfillment, inventory management, supply chain finance and other services for full-category MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) industrial products.
  • Core Advantages : Relying on JD's global supply chain network, local warehousing, distribution and compliance capabilities in Brazil , and digital procurement platform, we solve the pain points of the Brazilian market such as high prices, long delivery times, scattered suppliers and complex certifications .
  • Business Scope : Covering full MRO categories including tools, labor protection, electrical, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, and spare parts , supporting the dual model of cross-border procurement + local procurement , and realizingfast delivery, compliant customs clearance and credit period settlement in Brazil.

II. Key Job Responsibilities

1. Development and Management of Local MRO Suppliers in Brazil (Core)

  • In-depth development of local MRO suppliers in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.), and establishment of a localized supplier resource pool.
  • Responsible for supplier access, evaluation, negotiation, signing, maintenance and elimination, and building a hierarchical supplier system (head/potential/long-tail).
  • Familiar with the price system, certification requirements (INMETRO), delivery time, credit period and payment habits (OA 90 days, letter of credit installments) of the Brazilian MRO market.

2. MRO Category Procurement and Cost Management

  • Responsible for the full-category MRO procurement in Brazil, undertaking customer needs, and completing the entire process of inquiry, price comparison, negotiation, order placement, fulfillment, reconciliation and settlement.
  • Formulate category procurement strategies, price systems and cost targets, optimize procurement costs, and improve price competitiveness, gross profit and inventory turnover.
  • Analyze the supply and demand, competitors, prices, delivery times and policies of the Brazilian MRO market, and formulate category planning, commodity structure and stock-up strategies.

3. Customer Demand Connection and Solution Output

  • Connect with local Chinese-funded/large-scale enterprise customers in Brazil, explore MRO procurement needs, and provide one-stop procurement solutions, cost optimization, delivery guarantee and inventory management.
  • Coordinate the entire link of cross-border procurement, local procurement, customs clearance, logistics fulfillment and local delivery to ensure timely, compliant and low-cost delivery.
  • Maintain customer relationships, improve repurchase rate, satisfaction and penetration rate, and promote large customer signing, project landing and category expansion.

4. Supply Chain Operation and Data Management

  • Responsible for the entire link operation of MRO inventory, orders, delivery, reconciliation and settlement, ensuring healthy inventory, timely delivery, compliant credit period and fund safety.
  • Track data such as sales, procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time, and output weekly/monthly/analysis reports to support business decisions.
  • Coordinate with JD Industrial's global procurement, cross-border logistics, digital systems, risk control and compliance teams to ensure coordinated, efficient and compliant business operations.

5. Compliance and Risk Management

  • Familiar with Brazilian compliance requirements such as import tariffs, INMETRO certification, commodity inspection, customs declaration, taxation, foreign exchange and labor laws, ensuring that procurement and delivery are legal and compliant.
  • Control supplier risks, price risks, delivery risks, inventory risks, fund risks and compliance risks.

III. Job Requirements

1. Core Competencies (Must-Have)

  • Local MRO Supplier Resources in Brazil : Must have local MRO industrial product supplier resources in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.).
  • MRO Procurement Professional Ability : 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement experience in Brazil/Latin America, familiar with MRO categories, products, prices, certifications, delivery times, credit periods and procurement processes.
  • In-depth Understanding of the Brazilian Market : Familiar with Brazil's industrial market, customer structure, supplier ecology, price system, certification (INMETRO), tariffs, foreign exchange and payment habits.

2. Professional Skills

  • Business Negotiation : Strong ability in price negotiation, negotiation, contract signing and supplier management.
  • Cost and Data Analysis : Price-sensitive, strong cost awareness, proficient in analyzing procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time data.
  • Language Ability : Fluent in Portuguese (native/business level), proficient in English;
    fluent in Chinese is preferred.
  • Office Tools : Proficient in Excel, PPT, Word and ERP/procurement systems.

3. Comprehensive Quality

  • Business Thinking : Possess the ability of category operation, cost control, profit orientation and inventory management.
  • Customer Orientation : Customer-first, strong service awareness, demand exploration, solution output and customer maintenance.
  • Pressure Resistance and Execution : Result-oriented, strong pressure resistance, strong execution, cross-departmental collaboration and rapid implementation.
  • Compliance and Integrity : Integrity and self-discipline, strong compliance awareness, risk control and high professional quality.

4. Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above , major in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is preferred.
  • 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement/sales experience in Brazil/Latin America;
    experience in local Brazilian supplier resources, Chinese-funded enterprise services and cross-border procurement is preferred.

IV. What We Offer

  • International Platform : JD Industrial's global business, with collaboration between the local Brazilian team and the China headquarters.
  • Salary and Benefits : Highly competitive salary + performance bonus + annual bonus + local Brazilian social security + commercial insurance + paid annual leave + overseas subsidies.
  • Development Space : Promotion paths such as MRO Category Manager, Regional Procurement & Sales Director, and JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader.
  • Localization Support : Local office in Brazil, local team, compliance support, supply chain support and customer resources.

title: International Treasury Specialist
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.


About the role


This is a highly specialized international treasury role , designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Specialist will operate independently , owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe .

This is not a transactional AP role .

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity , requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.


Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers , and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.G., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting , FP&A , and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations


Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone , without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders


Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments , especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance


Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments


Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

title: Api Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer API standards and architectural guidelines.


Responsibilities

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Sodexo's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool
  • Experience on Azure, Phyton and API development lifecycle.


What can you expect from us?


- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Analista De Mercado Financeiro
description:

O time de Product Analysis é responsável por realizar análises técnicas de mercado financeiro que sustentam a implementação de novos produtos no Gorila. Aprimoramento Contínuo:

  • Conhecimento em mercado financeiro e matemática financeira.
  • Experiência no uso avançado do pacote Office (Excel, Word e PowerPoint).
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência python e outras linguagens;
  • Experiência de trabalho no mercado financeiro (1 ano +);
  • Conhecimento sobre APIs;
  • Conhecimento debanco de dados.


Conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Sólido conhecimento de produtos financeiros;

title: Senior Software Engineer - Game Technology
description:
We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo.


At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day.


Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs.
  • Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes.
  • Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast.
  • Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes.
  • Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality.
  • Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming.
  • Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale.
  • Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers.
  • Working proficiency in English.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development.
  • Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure.
  • Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products.


MORE ABOUT YOU

You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it.


ABOUT WILDLIFE

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About The Role

You'll join an established Data & AI team working on our Centralized Data Infrastructure platform. This is a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse that serves as the single source of truth for all analytics, operations, and AI products across the company.

This is not a maintenance role. You'll be building and modeling data pipelines that directly enable AI products, every source you integrate and every model you design unlocks new capabilities for the business. The data you shape will power an AI Candidate Matching Engine, Conversational BI, an Onboarding Agent, and a Recruiter Copilot.

We need someone who can pick up complex data challenges, own their deliverables end-to-end, and ship independently within a collaborative team.


What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain data pipelines across a three-zone lakehouse architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) on Microsoft Fabric
  • Integrate new data sources — VMS platforms (FieldGlass, Beeline, Magnit), ATS (JobDiva), payroll systems, HR data, communication platforms, and job boards
  • Design star schema models that transform raw operational data into analytics-ready and AI-ready datasets. You'll reshape a 71+ table ATS schema into clean dimensional models.
  • Implement data quality rules — deduplication, PII classification and masking, cross-source entity resolution, validation frameworks
  • Support API integrations — RESTful API consumption, webhook handling, and fallback scraping/bot pipelines where APIs aren't available
  • Collaborate with the AI Products squad to ensure data pipelines produce the features and formats AI models need


What We're Looking For

Must have (3-7 years of experience):

  • Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric (or equivalent: Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake. Fabric experience preferred)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data transformation and pipeline orchestration
  • Experience designing dimensional models (star schema, slowly changing dimensions, fact/dimension tables)
  • Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipelines at scale — batch and incremental loads
  • Familiarity with API integrations — REST APIs, OAuth, webhook-based data ingestion
  • Understanding of data quality frameworks — validation rules, anomaly detection, reconciliation
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric specifically (lakehouses, notebooks, data pipelines, warehouses)
  • PySpark / Spark for large-scale data processing
  • Experience with ATS or staffing industry data (JobDiva, Bullhorn, or similar)
  • Familiarity with data governance — RLS, PII masking, audit trails
  • Experience with VMS platforms or their APIs (FieldGlass, Beeline, Magnit)
  • Knowledge of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold pattern)
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD for data pipelines


Why This Role

  • High impact Your work directly enables reporting, automation and AI products.
  • Own your projects: You won't be waiting for someone to tell you what to do. You'll take ownership of specific data domains and deliver them end-to-end — from ingestion to business/AI-ready models.
  • AI-first environment: The data you build is consumed by LLM-powered products, not just dashboards. You'll work alongside AI engineers pushing the boundaries of what's possible in staffing.
  • Deepen your expertise: As the platform grows in complexity and the team scales toward a Data Platform Squad (3-4 engineers), there's room to become a deep technical specialist in the areas you care about most.

title: Médico Intensivista (Vaga Afirmativa)
description:
ESTA VAGA PRIORIZA pessoas negras, indígenas, com deficiência e/ou trans , de acordo com a portaria GM/MS Nº 5.801, de 28 de novembro de 2024.


Olá, somos o Hospital Sírio-Libanês!

Somos uma instituição de saúde centenária, que através da sua atuação em mais de 60 especialidades, tem como propósito levar vida plena e digna a um número cada vez maior de pessoas. A cada ano, contribuímos para a formação de profissionais da saúde e atendemos milhares de pacientes.

Nos orgulhamos do nosso caráter filantrópico, de um compromisso social genuíno e de sermos uma das melhores instituições de saúde do mundo reconhecida pela revista Newsweek (2023) além de sermos uma empresa TOP Employers , nos destacando entre as melhores instituições do mundo em práticas de Recursos Humanos.

Desta maneira, acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade.


Queremos você para fazer parte dessa história!


Sírio-Libanês para todos e todas!

Acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura, por isso respeitamos as individualidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas que acreditam em seu potencial e detêm os requisitos técnicos para executar a função escolhida. Você pode participar dos nossos processos seletivos independentemente de deficiência, raça, etnia, idade, religião, sexo biológico, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, expressão de gênero ou biótipo.

O Sírio-Libanês é uma instituição plural e queremos ser cada vez mais. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade!


O que você vai encontrar neste desafio?

Estamos vivendo em um mundo que está passando por grandes transformações de maneira rápida. Um mundo cada vez mais ágil e digital. Acreditamos na mudança e evolução para sermos cada vez melhores, buscando uma experiência inspiradora.

Por isso, pensando na nossa experiência, queremos ouvir e cuidar cada vez mais das nossas pessoas. Nossa principal missão é incentivar a transformação organizacional por meio da influência, sendo provocador das mudanças que possam elevar a um patamar de inovação e tecnologia para alavancar cada vez mais a competitividade, sem deixar de pensar no nosso potencial, em sermos extraordinários e evoluirmos na jornada do colaborador.


Neste desafio você será responsável por:

  • Responsável pela assistência médica para os pacientes internados nas unidades críticas de pacientes adultos;
  • Conhecer os detalhes dos casos, atentando para todas as suas dimensões e traçando o seu plano de cuidado;
  • Participar da visita multiprofissional à beira leito, registrando o plano de cuidados dos pacientes;
  • Compartilhar a visão do paciente crítico com as demais equipes assistenciais, buscando participar das decisões e negociar diferentes pontos de vista;
  • Possuir habilidades de acolhimento e empatia, além de capacidade de resolução de conflitos entre equipe médica/assistencial e familiares;
  • Exercer proatividade para antever e resolver problemas que envolvam o atendimento ao paciente.


Para este desafio você precisará:

  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • Residência em Terapia Intensiva ou Título de Especialista em Terapia Intensiva pela AMIB;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na assistência a pacientes críticos após a conclusão da especialização;
  • Disponibilidadede horário.

Regime: Horista

Local: São Paulo / SP

A Cushman & Wakefield é uma empresa multinacional que atua no ramo imobiliário. Trabalhamos para sermos o provedor global preferencial de serviços imobiliários, oferecendo as soluções mais criativas e inovadoras de forma consistente, gerando valor significativo aos nossos clientes.   • Garantir a assertividade, pontualidade e precisão dos dados coletados, que serão base para relatórios e análises apresentadas aos clientes;


Requisitos para esta posição:


  • Estudantes de Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Imobiliário ou áreas correlatas;
  • Perfil proativo, organizado, pontual e comprometido;
  • Boa comunicaçãoe interesse em atuar na área comercial e no mercado imobiliário corporativo;

  • Desejo genuíno de aprender com profissionais altamente capacitados e crescer junto com a equipe;

Aqui, você vai aprender não apenas sobre as tarefas operacionais da área, mas também sobre estratégias de representação de inquilinos, estruturação de negociações, relacionamento com clientes corporativos e o funcionamento real do mercado de escritórios no Brasil — tudo isso dentro de um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.

Este aprendizado das tarefas operacionais e de suporte tem como objetivo o entendimento do processo, para futuramente conduzir o processo, em um 1o momento com o apoio de um consultor e posteriormente, com autonomia.

title: Analista De Dp Sr - Folha De Pagamento
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 16 países, com mais de 2.000 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity, Kore, TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

title: Analista De Web Analytics Pleno
description:
Position Objective:

Apoiar a mensuração e análise do comportamento dos usuários nos canais digitais de e-commerce e aplicativos de vendas de produtos de Gaming , garantindo que o tracking esteja corretamente implementado e que as principais métricas de produto e funil sejam acompanhadas com qualidade. A posição contribui para decisões táticas de evolução do produto e performance por meio de relatórios, diagnósticos e insights acionáveis, com reporte direto à Diretoria de Produto/Tecnologia e atuação próxima a times de Produto, Engenharia, Marketing e Comercial .


Main Responsibilities:

Tracking & Instrumentation Support:

  • Apoiar a definição e manutenção do plano de mensuração (eventos, parâmetros e conversões) sob orientação, garantindo padronização de nomenclaturas.
  • Implementar e ajustar tags via Google Tag Manager (ou ferramenta equivalente) conforme especificações, mantendo organização e versionamento básico.
  • Realizar validações e testes de tracking (ex.: debug, conferência de eventos, duplicidades, perdas), sinalizando inconsistências e propondo correções.
  • Apoiar a instrumentação junto ao time de engenharia (ex.: solicitações de dataLayer, ajustes de eventos), acompanhando até a resolução.

Product Analytics & Reporting (Olhar de Produto):

  • Monitorar métricas-chave de produto e jornada (ex.: conversão por etapa, engajamento, adoção de funcionalidades), ajudando a identificar tendências e anomalias.
  • Elaborar análises recorrentes de funil e segmentos (ex.: por canal, dispositivo, página/fluxo), com recomendações objetivas e aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar a definição e acompanhamento de indicadores de sucesso de iniciativas (ex.: novas features, ajustes de fluxo), ajudando a medir impacto antes/depois.
  • Contribuir com insights para melhoria de UX e produto, conectando dados de comportamento a hipóteses de otimização.

Dashboards & Operational Routines:

  • Construir e manter dashboards e relatórios em ferramentas como Looker Studio/Power BI/Looker (ou equivalentes), garantindo consistência visual e de definição.
  • Atualizar documentação básica (dicionário de métricas, lista de eventos, owners e links de painéis), mantendo material acessível ao time.
  • Apoiar rotinas de acompanhamento (semanal/mensal), preparando insumos e leituras para stakeholders.

Growth Analytics & Experimentação :

  • Apoiar iniciativas de growth com análises orientadas a aquisição, ativação, retenção e receita (framework AARRR), identificando oportunidades de melhoria no funil de conversão do e-commerce e app.
  • Contribuir com a estruturação e análise de experimentos (testes A/B, multivariados), apoiando times de Produto e Growth na definição de hipóteses, tamanho de amostra e leitura de resultados com significância estatística.
  • Monitorar KPIs de growth (CAC, LTV, churn, NPS transacional, taxa de recompra), conectando comportamento do usuário a métricas de negócio e gerando insumos para decisões de produto e marketing.
  • Apoiar análises de cohort, segmentação de usuários e mapeamento de jornadas críticas (ex.: primeiro acesso, abandono de carrinho, reativação), colaborando com times de CRM e Marketing para iniciativas de personalização e retenção.

AI & Automação Aplicada à Análise :

  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA generativa (ex.: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) e assistentes de análise para acelerar exploração de dados, geração de hipóteses, sumarização de relatórios e automação de tarefas analíticas recorrentes.
  • Apoiar a detecção de anomalias e padrões em dados de comportamento com auxílio de modelos preditivos simples ou funcionalidades nativas de IA em ferramentas como GA4 (Insights), Looker ou BigQuery ML.
  • Explorar e propor o uso responsável de IA como camada de produtividade analítica: criação de queries assistidas, geração automatizada de narrativas de dados e enriquecimento de relatórios com contexto interpretativo.

Governance, Privacy & Good Practices:

  • Seguir boas práticas de privacidade e LGPD no uso de dados e implementação de tags, escalando dúvidas ou riscos para liderança/área responsável.
  • Contribuir para padronização de processos de tracking e reporte, reduzindo divergência de números e retrabalho entre áreas.


Required Qualifications:

  • Experiência prévia com Web Analytics e acompanhamento de métricas digitais.
  • Conhecimento de GA4, FullStory e Google Tag Manager, incluindo validação de eventos e tags.
  • Vivência ou interesse demonstrável em Growth Analytics : noções de funil AARRR, análise de cohort, testes A/B e métricas de retenção/monetização (diferencial valorizado para o nível).
  • Familiaridade com uso de ferramentas de IA generativa no contexto analítico (geração de queries, sumarização de dados, automação de relatórios);
    postura de aprendizado contínuo em relação a novas tecnologias de IA aplicadas à análise.
  • Conhecimento básico a intermediário de SQL para consultas simples e validaçõesserá um diferecial.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de dashboard (Grafana/Looker Studio/Power BI/Looker ou equivalentes).
  • Capacidade de interpretar funis e métricas de produto, conectando dados a hipóteses de melhoria.
  • Inglês intermediário
  • Formação superior completa ou em curso preferencialmente em áreas analíticas/tecnologia/negócios.

title: Talent Acquisition Sr Analyst
description:
