title: Llm Application Engineer
description:
The Role

You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.


What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem


Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

  • Experiência comsegmentação de clientes, análise de comportamento de canais e performance de campanhas e ações;
  • Capacidade de transformar dados em insights claros e recomendações acionáveis;
  • Perfil analítico, com visão estratégica, autonomia e boa comunicação.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com dados de canais digitais e comportamento de consumo phygital;

title: L3 Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Support Engineer

Location: Itaim Bibi, São Paulo, SP, Brazil


Job Summary

We are seeking a hands-on L3 Support Engineer to serve as the escalation point for critical production issues across trading and risk systems. This role focuses on deep incident diagnosis, collaborating with engineering teams to implement fixes and improve system reliability, and building tools, runbooks, and documentation to enable L1/L2 teams to resolve issues efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own L3 escalations end-to-end, including triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to enhance system reliability, observability, and supportability (logging, monitoring, alerting).
  • Develop scripts, diagnostic tools, and runbooks to streamline troubleshooting and reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR).
  • Create and maintain documentation for L1/L2 teams;
    conduct knowledge-sharing and enablement sessions.
  • Participate in incident reviews and problem management processes, driving permanent fixes and automation for recurring issues.
  • Support a limited on-call/weekend rotation (approximately 4–6 weekends per year) with compensatory time off.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering or production support.
  • Proficiency in Java or similar programming language with strong debugging capabilities.
  • Experience with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting (Bash).
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to handle high-pressure production incidents with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and tools such as GitLab, JIRA, and incident management platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting trading platforms or working with front-office/trading desks in financial institutions.
  • Strong SQL skills for data analysis and issue triage.
  • Experience in microservices-based architectures and object-oriented programming environments.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, and PagerDuty.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.


Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.


We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.


WHAT DO WE EXPECT?


- Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

- Advanced English (spoken and written),

- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.


WHAT AWAITS YOU?


- Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

- Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,

- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,

- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?


- Hybrid working model,

- One day off on your birthday,

- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

- Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.


In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.


In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Senior Sap Tax Specialist
description:
Senior SAP Tax Specialist

São Paulo, Brazil


Project: Brazil Localization (S/4HANA)

Contract: 6‑month contract + extension

Start: Immediate / ASAP

Work Model: Hybrid – 3 days on‑site / 2 days remote


Overview


We are seeking a Senior SAP Tax Specialist to lead the tax workstream for a major SAP S/4HANA implementation at a large multinational organisation within the consumer / retail sector in Brazil.


This role acts as the technical and strategic reference for Brazilian taxation, ensuring that complex local tax requirements are fully compliant and seamlessly integrated into global SAP processes. The consultant will also contribute to innovation initiatives, including the use of AI‑enabled tools in tax automation and analytics.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design and implement Brazil Localization solutions covering direct and indirect taxes, ensuring end‑to‑end compliance and process integrity.
  • Configure and optimise TAXBRA and/or partner tax engines (e.G. Thomson Reuters / ONESOURCE where applicable).
  • Ensure compliance with ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS and withholding tax requirements.
  • Lead integration between SAP Tax and MM, SD, FI and Logistics processes.
  • Translate Brazilian legal and fiscal changes into clear SAP system requirements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT stakeholders on Brazilian tax strategy within SAP.


Technical Skills & Experience


  • Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA and New General Ledger / Universal Journal in a tax context.
  • Hands‑on experience with Condition‑Based Tax (CBT) and Exception / Pivot Table mapping.
  • Experience with TDF (Tax Declaration Framework) and/or ACR (Advanced Compliance Reporting).
  • Solid knowledge of SPED Fiscal, SPED Contributions and EFD‑REINF.
  • Experience with tax‑relevant supplier and material master data sanitisation.
  • Ability to leverage AI‑based tools or coding assistants to accelerate tax rule mapping and data analysis.


Please apply now with your updated CV for immediate consideration.

title: Pharmacovigilance Analyst (12-Month Contract, Remote)
description:
Pharmacovigilance Analyst (12-Month Contract, Remote)

  • São Paulo, Brazil (Remote with occasional office visits)
  • Occasional in-office presence required (1–2 times per month)


About the role

We are seeking a Pharmacovigilance Analyst to support local and global drug safety activities within a dynamic, international environment. This role focuses on ensuring compliance, supporting safety processes, and maintaining oversight of pharmacovigilance (PV) systems and agreements.

You will work closely with Local Safety Officers (LSOs) and cross-regional teams to ensure consistent and compliant safety practices across the organization.

Key responsibilities

  • Support Local Safety Officers with operational pharmacovigilance activities and ensure inspection readiness
  • Manage and maintain oversight of local PV agreements across regions
  • Review and support negotiation and execution of pharmacovigilance agreements with external partners
  • Ensure accuracy and maintenance of safety documentation (e.G., PSMF Annexes, service agreements)
  • Develop, update, and implement local PV procedures aligned with global and local requirements
  • Contribute to process improvements within pharmacovigilance operations

Requisitos

OTE (ganhos totais estimados): entre US$ 3.875 e US$ 5.000 mensais

Modelo remoto, de segunda a sexta-feira, com atuação alinhada ao fuso horário MST dos EUA.

Cultura colaborativa de alta performance, focada em extrair o melhor de cada membro do time.

Nosso processo avalia experiência, abordagem e alinhamento com os valores da Viral Coach.

Location: Remote – Brazilian Residents ONLY (must be available to work in U.S. Mountain Standard Timezone hours)

About Viral Coach

Viral Coach helps businesses grow visibility and brand presence through organic social media, paid ads, and digital marketing strategies. Our team includes social media experts with backgrounds at Amazon, PayPal, NerdWallet, and more. We work with small-to-medium sized businesses ($1–50M revenue) and are expanding quickly to support client growth.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Media Buyer with Meta & Google Ads experience who’s equal parts strategist, optimizer, and expert. You’ll work directly with Viral Coach clients to audit, manage, and optimize their paid advertising strategies.

Depending on each client’s needs, your work will range from high-level coaching and performance reviews to full-stack campaign management. You’ll play a key role in helping business owners understand how to grow through paid media while ensuring every dollar spent delivers measurable results.

  • Manage & optimize ad campaigns across clients

Compensation

Culture

Fast-paced, collaborative, high standards, zero drama. We win by making our clients win.

Remote role, Monday–Friday, aligned with your time zone (must overlap with MST hours).


Support

Collaborative, high-performance culture that pushes everyone to perform at their best.


Our Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to assess experience, approach, and alignment with Viral Coach values.

It includes an initial Loom introduction video. Selected candidates will then complete a short practical knowledge exam, where you’ll review sample ad data and provide strategic recommendations.

Candidates will then be invited to interview.

title: Sales Development Representative - Brazil
description:

The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.

title: Managing Director – Brazil (Crypto Payment Business)
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred


Overview:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.



Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese;
    strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.



Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: O&M Head - Latam
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce


Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).


Key Responsibilities

(I) Team Management and Training

1. Establish, manage, and lead an international operation and maintenance team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and personnel allocation.

2. Organize team training and technical exchange activities to improve the overall skill level and professional knowledge of the team.

(II) Safety and Quality Control

1. Ensure that operation and maintenance work complies with international safety standards and norms, and establish a sound safety management system.

2. Develop and implement quality control measures to ensure the quality and reliability of operation and maintenance work.

(III) Budget and Cost Management

1. Be responsible for the preparation and control of the operation and maintenance budget, reasonably arrange operation and maintenance expenses, and reduce operation and maintenance costs.

2. Analyze cost data and find opportunities and measures for cost optimization.

(IV) Cooperation and Communication

1. Establish good cooperative relationships with international suppliers and service providers, coordinate resources, and ensure the smooth progress of operation and maintenance work.

2. Maintain effective communication with relevant parties such as government departments and power grid companies in the project location to ensure compliant operation and a good external environment.

(V) Data Analysis and Reporting

1. Collect and analyze operation and maintenance data, evaluate wind farm performance, and provide regular operation and maintenance reports and improvement suggestions.

2. Utilize data analysis to optimize operation and maintenance strategies and decisions.


Job Requirements

(I) Educational Background:

Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Renewable Energy, or related fields.

(II) Work Experience:

1. At least five years of experience in wind power project operation and maintenance management, with priority given to candidates with international project experience.

2. Familiar with international wind power industry operation and maintenance standards and specifications.

(III) Skills Requirements:

1. Fluent in English (it will be tested). Spanish is a plus

2. Proficient in using relevant operation and maintenance management software and tools.

3. Strong ability to diagnose and resolve problems.

(IV) Competencies and Qualities:

1. Excellent team management and leadership skills, able to effectively motivate and coordinate multicultural teams.

2. Excellent communication, coordination, and negotiation skills, able to effectively cooperate with international parties.

3. Strong adaptability and resilience, able to cope with various challenges and changes in international projects.

title: Area Sales Manager (Pernambuco, Bahia State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.


To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Pernambuco, Bahia State for an:


Area Sales Manager


General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.


Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.


A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.


You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.


“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.


Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.


Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Cientista De Dados
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist, who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will

LLMs & Agent Engineering

  • RAG Pipelines: Design and implement Retrieval‑Augmented Generation architectures based on the operations history, enabling agents to retrieve context from past decisions.

Data Science & Analytics

  • Effectiveness Modeling: Build analytical models to measure the real effectiveness of buying and selling strategies over time.

  • Dashboards: Support the creation of analytical reports with comparative historical views.
  • Energy Market: Work with price data and market parameters.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Integrity: Define quality criteria for opportunity, strategy, and result data.
  • Monitoring: Track model drift and agent performance in production.
  • Documentation: Record experiments, hypotheses, and results in a structured manner to ensure organizational memory.


Mandatory Skills

  • Python for DS: Solid experience with libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit‑learn.
  • Experience with LLMs: Use of APIs, prompt engineering, and output evaluation.
  • RAG Architectures: Experience with chunking, embedding, vector search, and reranking.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of tools such as pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
  • LLM Evaluation: Ability to apply objective metrics (e.G., ragas, LLM‑as‑judge).
  • Time Series: Experience with analysis and modeling of market time‑series data.


Desirable Skills

  • Energy Sector: Experience in the free energy market or commodity trading.
  • Risk Mitigation: Techniques for evaluating and reducing hallucinations in RAG systems.
  • Observability: Experience monitoring AI flows and model health in production.

Descrição da vaga

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Cada solução é pensada para tornar as interações simples, rápidas e seguras, garantindo que as aplicações ofereçam fluidez e consistência. Trabalhamos para que a arquitetura, os Agentes e os serviços de IA habilitem jornadas generativas intuitivas, escaláveis e resilientes, conectando tecnologia e as necessidades para entregar valor real aos itubers e clientes.


Estamos buscando profissionais que dominem e possuam forte acuidade arquitetural, que tenha uma forte atuação hands-on em IA, domínio de DDD e design de plataformas que habilitem reuso e evolução contínua, com visão estratégica e capacidade de inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Especialista de Arquitetura de Dados & IA , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Nessa função você vai:


Arquitetura e Plataforma

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA para o Banco PJ (alta escala, reuso, baixo acoplamento, personalizável), com observabilidade e tolerância a falhas de ponta a ponta.
  • Liderar decisões sobre tecnologias de IA Generativa guiado por trade-offs claros entre latência, consistência, capacidade de experimentação, custo e time-to-market.
  • Desenhar e governar soluções de IA e Agentes Generativos (aggregation, routing, orchestration, caching, personalization, feature flags, A/B) que sirvam múltiplos agentes trazendo jornadas generativas estáveis, versionamento, backward compatibility e observabilidade por domínio.
  • Direcionar o reuso dos capabilities/domain services (crm, auth, AI Models, CC, limites, PaaS), com bounded contexts bem definidos, APIs consistentes, catálogo de eventos e SDKs reutilizáveis.


Excelência de Arquitetura de Soluções

  • Tomar decisões de arquitetura usando DDD (ubiquitous language, aggregates, domain events, anticorruption layer) e arquitetura hexagonal (ports & adapters).
  • Implantar boas práticas: idempotência, backpressure, circuit breakers, retry with jitter, dead-letter queues, saga/outbox, blue/green & canary, zero-downtime migrations, security by design.
  • Garantir observabilidade abrangente (logs estruturados, tracing distribuído), SLOs por serviço e acompanhamento dos postmortems para aplicar ações de melhoria.
  • Otimizar custos na AWS (right-sizing, autoscaling, spot/ savings plans, cache e storage tiers, redução de chatter entre serviços).

title: Auditor Sênior
description:
Main responsibilities of the position:


Job Summary:


The Senior Auditor within Global Internal Audit (GIA) executes independent, objective assurance and advisory activities to assess the effectiveness of the Bank’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. This hands‑on role supports audit engagements across all phases, including planning, risk assessment, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation, and may lead assigned audit components or workstreams. The Senior Auditor is responsible for delivering assigned audit activities and documentation, identifying risks and control gaps, developing clear and actionable recommendations, and supporting the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, coordination, and stakeholder communication.


Major Responsibilities:


  • Execute risk‑based internal audit engagements in accordance with the IIA’s International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF), GIA Methodology, and applicable banking regulatory expectations.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Apply professional skepticism and personal accountability to identify control weaknesses, assess root causes, and evaluate the impact on risk and risk management practices.
  • Generate insightful, well‑articulated audit observations that clearly convey significance, risk impact, and management implications, and report audit findings and issues to Audit Management.
  • Prepare and maintain high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that fully support audit conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Support the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, issue validation, and effective communication with management and key stakeholders.
  • Operate with an innovative and flexible mindset by continuously identifying opportunities to enhance audit consistency, efficiency, quality, and overall value.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with business, risk, and compliance partners while preserving independence and objectivity.


Desired experience for the role:


  • 4+ years of progressive experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, or compliance, preferably within banking or financial services.
  • Experience executing risk‑based internal audit engagements end‑to‑end, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation.
  • Hands‑on experience evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Experience applying IIA IPPF standards and working within environments subject to banking regulatory oversight.
  • Experience producing stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that support conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Experience developing and reporting clear, risk‑focused audit observations that articulate significance, root cause, and impact on risk and risk management practices.


Specific knowledge, skills, and certifications required for the role:


  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, required due to audit methodology, documentation, and regular interaction with global and local stakeholders conducted in English.
  • CIA preferred;
    CISA, CRMA, CRC, CPA-10, CPA-20 or equivalent professional certification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of internal audit principles, risk‑based auditing, and internal control frameworks within a banking environment.
  • Ability to apply professional skepticism, sound judgment, and personal accountability when evaluating risks and controls.
  • Capability to develop clear, risk‑focused audit observations and communicate issues effectively to Audit Management and stakeholders.
  • Ability to prepare high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation that supports conclusions and enables independent re‑performance.
  • 'Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (e.G., MBA or Master’s in Accounting/Finance) is a plus.
